listingTitle: Keep browser globals out of module initialization
title: Keep browser globals out of module initialization
why: Module scripts can execute during server rendering, where browser-only globals are unavailable.
suggestion: Move browser work to instance onMount/$effect or guard it with the SvelteKit browser environment.
limitations: Only explicit syntax inside discovered .svelte components is analyzed.
Custom lifecycle wrappers, aliased browser globals, and behavior in generated components are not resolved.
